name: Dover Public Library
access: Submit an STL via the online form or by email (libraryquestions@dover.nh.gov). Staff review every file before printing.
source: City of Dover, NH: 3D Print service page and library 3D Printer Policy
notes: Service page and policy both confirmed. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) at the library address.

name: Louisville Public Library
type: PUBLIC LIBRARY // FREE PRINT BY REQUEST
access: Free 3D printing by request through the library's online form. You can upload your own .stl; staff review it before printing.
notes: Public use of the printer itself is not offered; submission is by request only. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim).

name: Yonkers Public Library, Riverfront Branch
access: Free to submit through the library's 3D print request form. Limit of 3 items per person per month; prints must finish in 5 hours or less. Pickup at the Riverfront Library circulation desk.
source: Yonkers Public Library: 3D Printing services page and 3D Printing Policy and Request Form
notes: The sources disagree on eligibility: the policy limits the service to Yonkers card holders, while another page mentions Westchester cards. Confirm before submitting. Address comes from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), not from the library's own page.

name: Toronto Reference Library
access: No online upload. Bring the file on a USB drive or book a slot with the branch. Jobs are capped at about 2 hours. A Toronto Public Library card is required.
source: Toronto Public Library: 3D Printers and 3D design and print pages
notes: Address comes from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim). Other TPL branches with 3D printers are not listed yet.

name: North Vancouver District Public Library, Lynn Valley Branch
address: 1277 Lynn Valley Rd, North Vancouver, BC V7J 0A2
access: Send an .stl with the 3D printing request form to get a quote. Staff email a cost estimate, and the job starts only after you approve it. Requires an NVDPL card in good standing.
fee: $1 for the first 10 g, then $0.10 per gram (supports included)
source: North Vancouver District Public Library: 3D printing terms of use and StoryLab 3D printing page
notes: The StoryLab contact is 604.984.0286 ext. 8139. The address is from the NVDPL Lynn Valley listing, and the coordinates are from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim).

name: Portsmouth Public Library
equipment: Flashforge Creator Pro (Ada) and Flashforge Finder (Sibyl), PLA
access: Find a model (e.g. Thingiverse) and send the .STL through the library's online request form. Staff review each file and may refuse a request. Objects must take less than 10 hours to print. Eligibility is not stated on the page, so confirm with the library.
fee: $0.10 per gram of finished print; staff check in with you before prints over $5.00
source: City of Portsmouth, NH: 3D Printing service page (portsmouthnh.gov/node/7146)
notes: Page lists two printers, $0.10/gram fee, 10-hour limit, build sizes, and library hours. No last-updated date on the page. Hours on the page: Mon-Thu 10-8, Fri-Sat 10-5, Sun 1-5 Sep-May, closed Sun Jun-Aug.

name: Belmont Public Library
equipment: 3D printer (PLA; colored PLA cannot be requested)
access: Submit a finalized .STL through the online form with a library card number. Each person may have one request at a time. Prints must finish in under 6 hours and fit 220 x 220 x 220 mm. Pick up within two weeks of being contacted. The library will not print copyrighted items or gun parts.
source: Belmont Public Library: 3D print submission page
notes: Form requires a library card number, so cardholders are effectively the eligible group. Hours on the page: Mon-Thu 9-9, Fri-Sat 9-5, Sun 1-5.

name: Norfolk Public Library
type: PUBLIC LIBRARY // FREE PRINT BY REQUEST
access: Submit a request through the online form with a web link to a design hosted on Makerworld, Thingiverse, Cults3D or Printables. Jobs must take 8 hours or less, and the library may lower that limit when the queue is full.
source: Norfolk Public Library: Request a 3D Print page
notes: Page does not say whether only patrons can request. Street address is from the geocoder (page lists only a phone and email); confirm before relying on it.

name: Boston Public Library, Kirstein Business Library & Innovation Center
access: Schedule a build through the library's online form for the branch you choose (Kirstein or Jamaica Plain). Designs must be .STL. Builds must take 7 hours or less, with one build per person per month. Files print as submitted, and colors cannot be requested. Pickup is at the Kirstein reference desk.
fee: Not stated on the guidelines page
notes: Guidelines page gives no cost and no policy date. Address is from the geocoder, not the page. Jamaica Plain Branch also takes submissions.
